title: Genesis Bible Quiz - Chapter 44
description: Ten questions on Genesis 44: Joseph's silver cup in Benjamin's sack and Judah's plea for his brother.

questions.text: What did Joseph have put in the sack of the youngest brother?
questions.explanation: Joseph told his steward, "Put my cup, the silver cup, in the sack's mouth of the youngest, with his grain money."

questions.text: What question was the steward told to ask when he overtook the men?
questions.explanation: Joseph told the steward to ask them, "Why have you rewarded evil for good?"

answers.text: "Why did you not pay for the grain?"
"Why have you rewarded evil for good?"
"Who sent you to spy on the land?"

questions.text: In what order did the steward search the sacks?
questions.explanation: He searched beginning with the oldest and ending at the youngest.

answers.text: From the youngest to the oldest
From the oldest to the youngest
Only the sacks on the donkeys

questions.text: In whose sack was the cup found?
questions.explanation: The cup was found in Benjamin's sack.

questions.text: What did the brothers do when the cup was found?
questions.explanation: They tore their clothes, each man loaded his donkey, and they returned to the city.

answers.text: They ran away toward Canaan as fast as they could
They blamed Benjamin and left him behind
They tore their clothes and returned to the city
They fought the steward and his men

questions.text: What did Joseph say that a man like him could indeed do?
questions.explanation: Joseph said, "Don't you know that such a man as I can indeed do divination?"

questions.text: According to Judah, what had God found out?
questions.explanation: Judah said, "God has found out the iniquity of your servants."

questions.text: To whom did Judah say Joseph was equal?
questions.explanation: Judah asked Joseph not to let his anger burn against him, "for you are even as Pharaoh."

questions.text: According to Judah, what had his father said his wife bore him?
questions.explanation: Judah quoted his father: "You know that my wife bore me two sons."

questions.text: What did Judah ask Joseph to let him do at the end of his plea?
questions.explanation: Judah asked to stay as Joseph's slave instead of the boy, and to let the boy go up with his brothers.

answers.text: Go home and fetch their father
Pay for the cup with silver
Stay as a slave instead of the boy
Take the boy home and come back alone
